title: Os' Vibrant Retextured Glazed Terracotta
description: This pack retextures the glazed terracotta in their original vibrant colors. It provides a styled, modern aesthetic, combined with the beautiful Mojang colors.
body:
# What Does This Pack Do?

This pack retextures the glazed terracotta in the original vibrant colors. It provides a styled, modern aesthetic, combined with the beautiful Mojang colors.

Here are some 2x2 examples of the new textures.
![Picture of all the textures included in this pack](https://i.imgur.com/Ur0ObBg.png)

![Get 25% off your first month with Bisect hosting using promo code oslypsis](https://www.bisecthosting.com/partners/custom-banners/c3960ebf-eb9a-4a08-b6b5-d9ea5104a60a.png)https://bisecthosting.com/oslypsis

# Usage Rights
Using/modifying for personal use is allowed.

Use (even if modified) for monetized videos must include a link in the description back to this page.

Please ask before using my content in your mods/packs/etc. Do not redistribute.

Using this pack as a template to make your own textures that work the same way in game as mine do is allowed and encouraged. Please note that I've changed some of the names of the files from their vanilla counterparts - you will need to keep these names when changing out the textures or the files will not be able to find the textures.
